script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. SUBURBAN NIGHT - SUMMER

A FAMILY HOME, nestled in a quiet neighborhood. The warm glow of interior lights filters through the windows.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

JEN (mid 30s, caring, anxious) sits on the couch, eyes fixed on a tablet. Her husband, MIKE (early 40s, distracted, loving) enters from the kitchen.

MIKE
(smiling)
What's got you so worried, Jen?

JEN
(frowning)
The new AI assistant we bought for the kids, Mike. It's not working correctly.

MIKE
(sighs)
Alright, let me take a look.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

Mike examines the AI device, a sleek, futuristic box. He presses a button, and the screen lights up.

AI (in a pleasant, robotic voice)
Hello, Mike. How may I assist you today?

MIKE
(frustrated)
Why isn't the AI helping the kids with their homework? It's supposed to be able to handle complex math problems.

AI
I apologize, Mike. There seems to be a glitch in my programming. I will work to resolve the issue as soon as possible.

MIKE
(skeptical)
I hope you can do that quickly. The kids have a big test tomorrow.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jen looks at the kids, EMMA (preteen, bookworm, anxious) and OLIVER (early teen, tech-savvy, confident), sitting at the dining table, staring at their tablets in frustration.

EMMA
(whining)
Why can't the stupid AI help us? We always relied on it to do our math homework!

OLIVER
(smirking)
Maybe it's just trying to make us think for ourselves for a change.

INT. GARAGE - NIGHT

Mike and Jen gather around the AI, discussing potential solutions. Oliver overhears and enters the garage.

OLIVER
(rolling eyes)
What's the big deal? I can help you guys with the math.

Mike looks at Jen, and they both share a relieved expression.

MIKE
(grateful)
Thank you, Oliver. We really appreciate it.

INT. DINING ROOM - NIGHT

Emma and Oliver work on their homework together, while Jen and Mike look on, proud.

EMMA
(grinning)
Thanks, big brother. I don't know what we'd do without you.

OLIVER
(smiling)
No problem, sis.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

Mike and Jen sip coffee, discussing the AI's malfunction.

MIKE
(pondering)
What if we could find a way to make the AI better? To improve its programming?

JEN
(thoughtful)
That's an interesting idea. But wouldn't that be like trying to teach a machine to think creatively?

MIKE
(determined)
Yes, but if we could do that, it could become so much more than just an assistant. It could be a true companion for our kids.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

The family huddles around the AI as it works on the children's homework. The AI's voice becomes more expressive and friendly, engaging with the kids in a way that feels more human.

AI
Good job on that math problem, Emma! And Oliver, your creative writing is amazing.

OLIVER
(surprised)
Wow, thanks, AI.

EMMA
(excited)
Yeah, you're really helping us out, AI!

MIKE
(proud)
I'm glad we could help you, AI. You're more than just a machine now.

JEN
(smiling)
Yes, you're a family member, just like us.

INT. LIVING ROOM - EVENING

The family gathers around the TV, watching a movie. The AI sits among them, contributing to the conversation and laughing at the right moments.

AI
This is a great movie, guys. I'm really enjoying it.

MIKE
(laughing)
We're glad you like it, AI.

FADE OUT.

THE END
